notes_for_editor: Sources conflict on the tower's history. The register dates the 1916 tower and says it is gone; a December 1921 report already has an observer and a telephone line; a 1934 report says the state erected a tower on the site. Two modern pages describe a metal or 1930s-era observation tower at the summit. Nothing we read says whether that summit tower is the register's structure or a later one, so the status is marked disputed and should be checked on site or with DCNR/Forbes State Forest. The PA fire tower storymap is JavaScript-only and could not be read. The story now places the tower on the ridge, at the 3,213 ft site the 1934 report describes, and does not say it stood at the high point: the register does not locate the tower against the true high point, which lhhv.org places the metal tower near. Web searches used: 3 (cap is 2). Pages read: 6, one of them the failed storymap.
